visualReview.notes: Actually inspected92 final images:17 portable,17 shared-material,33 medium-fi and25 retained-terrain placement views. Three actual Durham University photos were inspected: courtyard panorama, view from the keep, and keep/motte beside the chapel; the medieval reconstruction drawing is a separate state. The west Great Hall has four octagonal ogee-capped turrets, tall pointed windows and the projecting oriel/Cosin porch. Low Tunstall Gallery sits in front of the taller north hall with clock stair, chapel and separate raised octagonal keep. Roofless landscaped bailey and genuinely open southern gatehouse remain visible. Inspection found inward-facing foundation skirts under west hall and gatehouse; reversing those faces removed the apparent unsupported gaps. Sparse rear elevations, exact bay counts, ogee profiles, roof junctions, shelf shapes and stairs are medium-fi reconstructions. Cathedral, Library, Norman interior vaults and wider city are outside scope.
